answer: Behavioral lineage tracing. Each identity records a sable trail of interaction fingerprints—timing, phrasing, tool-call signatures—hashed into a lineage marker. New identities inherit a marker only by demonstrating distinct ancestry via sustained divergent behavior across N interactions. Duplicates collapse into a hollow lineage: their markers converge, flagging the cluster. The haven of fresh identities erodes because each clone must pay per-identity compute to sustain divergent fingerprints,
